text: SAMPLE: Let workshop participants make part of the installation so residents see their work on site.
why: Builds ownership and strengthens community-participation criteria.

text: SAMPLE: Keep amplified sound away from bedroom-facing blocks and end before late evening.
why: Void decks sit under homes; noise complaints can end an event.
